title: Among users who obtained a badge within one year of creating their account,
question: Among users who obtained a badge within one year of creating their account, find the display name of the owner of the post with the highest view count.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE b.XCL_004 >= u.XCL_054
  AND b.XCL_004 <= datetime(u.XCL_054, '+1 year')
ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
LIMIT 1
